title: Studio read-only posture: a lock in the app chip and one "Read-only · Customize with an overlay" link in the item header replace the banner, the rail footer, the amber badge and the form strips
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decision 4. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91` with the read-only `app.objectstack.hotcrm` package open: the Data pillar says read-only in five places at once — the amber "Read-only" badge beside the package name in the shell header, the full-width banner "Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit.", the rail footer "Read-only", the Form tab's "Read-only layout — this package cannot be edited" badge, and the Form canvas strip "Read-only package · click a field to view its properties". The Automations and Access pillars add their own copies of the banner.

## Target

Two signals, the same in every pillar:

1. **App chip.** After the package name, a 12 px lock glyph and the word "Read-only" at 11 px muted, with a title that carries the current `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` sentence. This replaces the amber badge.
2. **Item header.** At the right of the item header row (object, flow, nav entry, permission set), one amber-tinted link, 28 px, 12 px / 500, with a layers glyph: "Read-only · Customize with an overlay", pointing at the package's metadata directory (`/apps/setup/metadata?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm` (the package id in the query), the route `BuilderLanding` already uses). For pillars whose item has no overlay route, the same chip renders without the link half.

Retired: the full-width banner in all pillars, the rail footer, the Form tab's read-only badge and the canvas strip (the Form tab keeps its plain Layout / Preview control; the sentence "click a field to view its properties" survives as the field card's title attribute). Publish drops to the outline disabled variant it already has; the rail's add button hides; "Add record" and record editing stay available because records are not metadata.

The wording ruling of objectui#11781 (`StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx`) is kept: the sentence it pins moves into the chip's title and the link's title rather than disappearing.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (shell header chip, the `readOnly` banner in each pillar, the Data rail footer, the Form tab badge and strip), `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` (the read-only strip), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (new key for the chip label; retired keys for the banner and footer in every locale).

## Acceptance

1. With the read-only package open, the string "Read-only" appears exactly twice in each pillar's DOM: the chip and the header link.
2. The header link lands on `/apps/setup/metadata?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm`.
3. `readOnlyWording-11781`, `interfacesReadOnly-11136`, `automationsReadOnly-11124`, `automationsReadOnlySelect-11546`, `navEditClosesOnReadOnly-11167`, `ObjectValidationsPanel.readOnlyLook-11781` and `ObjectFormDesigner.readOnlyDescription-11924` stay green or are updated in the same PR with the moved sentence, each ablated once.
4. Before/after screenshots of Data Records and Automations with the read-only package, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`, `pnpm check:i18n`.
- Lands after the shell header card (it edits the chip that card introduces).

Blocked-by: #12447

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
